notes.title: Tropical Demo: Out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198742/6ff041fed75b9a879ac5ba8453bdb4b780cf005f.png

After a long time of development, we are happy to finally get the first public release out & in the hands of players to experience & give feedback on. And for Nextfest!

We're very grateful to have a positive community to share this with. We're not done yet so we can't wait to hear what you think. So without further delay, we hope you enjoy!

Lets play!
Join us on 18+ Discord (New art, Updates, Chat) :)

The Demo
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414600/Tropical_Monster_Girls_Demo?utm_source=NxtNewsTub

Thanks for reading ;3
~Captain Cake
